subject: Vendr portal onboarding — evidence upload plan & sampling window
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@vendr.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr portal onboarding — evidence upload plan & sampling window

Hi Maria,

Thanks again for the onboarding intro last week. We want to kick off the evidence ingestion for Vendr profiles next week and I wanted to confirm a couple of operational items before we pick an upload mechanism:

- Minimum artifacts we expect up front: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent), CAIQ fragment export (JSON or spreadsheet), and at least three scoped control artifacts (e.g., syslog retention config, KMS rotation policy, ephemeral creds playbook).
- Sampling window: for our initial profile we prefer a 90-day evidence sample (we usually ask for a rolling 90 days of logs/configs). Is that feasible for Vendr?
- Preferred upload mechanism: Whistic/OneTrust link, SFTP, or API push. We lean toward API push to avoid manual steps — do you support pre-signed URLs or an API ingest?

I've attached our onboarding checklist to help map expectations: vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (see the Requirements tab). Can you confirm which of the above you can provide and the recommended upload path?

Target timeline: kickoff week of 7/1, evidence window transfer by 7/3 if possible.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.ms-excel, 24KB)]
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@vendr.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vendr Integrations <security@vendr.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 10:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal onboarding — evidence upload plan & sampling window

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the clear checklist — that helps a lot. We can meet the asks you outlined. Quick answers below: 

- SOC 2: we will provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (PDF).
- CAIQ fragments: we can export to a CSV/JSON.
- Scoped artifacts: we can include the KMS rotation policy, bucket lifecycle policy screenshots, and last 90 days of authentication logs (redacted PII).

Upload options: we support both Whistic and SFTP today; we also have a newer API ingest that accepts zipped evidence bundles with a manifest. The API requires an ephemeral API key for the first push — we can generate a scoped key for Redwood. I attached our standard upload instructions and expected manifest format.

Proposal: API ingest (ephemeral key) for automation + Whistic link as fallback for manual proofs. If that works, we will:
  1) generate an ephemeral API key valid for 48 hours,
  2) provide the API endpoint and manifest schema,
  3) accept a zipped bundle up to 500MB.

Attachment: vendr_upload_instructions.pdf (6 pages)

Let me know whether Redwood prefers API or Whistic, and who will own the API key handoff on your side.

Best,

Maria Lopez
Vendor Trust Specialist
Vendr
[Attachment: vendr_upload_instructions.pdf (application/pdf, 58KB)]

Hi Maria,

API ingest sounds good and matches our automation goals. We'll take the ephemeral key approach. Internal notes and plan below (so we have a single source of truth):

Plan (owner / ETA):
- Redwood security to request ephemeral key from Vendr (Kimberly) — action: request today, expect key by EOD
- Infra to stage ingest endpoint and test harness (Aditya) — action: provide a staging endpoint and create a small test bundle by 7/1
- Vendor security triage and verification (Ben) — validate manifest and spot-check the three scoped artifacts by 7/3

Acceptance criteria: manifest validates against Vendr schema, zipped bundle unpacks cleanly, SOC 2 PDF present and signed date within last 18 months, CAIQ mapping column present.

We will attach the kickoff materials to the shared folder and will run the first automated ingest on 7/1 morning PT. I've added a short kickoff doc — kickoff_mpp.docx — with the step-by-step we will follow.

Can Vendr confirm the key TTL and whether key rotation during a push is supported? Also please confirm whether the ingest endpoint enforces IP allowlists; if so, share the IPs we should allow.

Thanks — copying Aditya and Ben to coordinate infra and verification.

Kim

[Attachment: kickoff_mpp.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 18KB)]

Kim — quick confirmation from infra side:

- We'll prepare the staging ingest harness and a 5-file sample bundle by tomorrow (7/2).
- We'll accept a 48-hour ephemeral key; please ask Vendr to issue with a TTL and notify when it's generated.
- IP allowlist: we have a small set of egress IPs, but if Vendr can support token-based ephemeral auth that will be simpler than IP whitelisting.

Ben — once the first bundle is in staging, can you run the manifest validation and a spot-check on one KMS artifact?

Thanks — Aditya
